prop-nrb-002.text: Best bedsitter building in Roysambu! No water rationing, clean tiles, and biometric gate entrance makes you feel super safe.

prop-nrb-003.text: Top tier management, generator kicks in instantly during KPLC blackouts, pool is heated and always clean.

prop-bnb-001.author: Michael T. (UK Visitor)
prop-bnb-001.text: Stunning Kilimani studio BnB! Fast WiFi, super comfy bed, seamless self check-in keypad. Will definitely book again.

prop-nrb-001.author: Amina Mohamed
prop-nrb-001.text: Is this house still on the market? Interested in moving in on 1st of next month.

prop-nrb-001.author: Faith Mwende
prop-nrb-001.text: Is viewing free this weekend? I work in Westlands and Ruaka is perfect for my commute via Bypass.

replies.author: James Mwangi Properties
replies.text: Hello Faith! Yes, viewing is 100% free anytime between 9am and 6pm. The caretaker is on-site at the gate.

prop-nrb-001.author: Dennis Ochieng
prop-nrb-001.text: Can confirm water here is genuinely 24/7 borehole + council backup. My colleague moved in 3 months ago and loves the balcony view of Two Rivers!

prop-nrb-002.author: Kelvin Kiptoo (USIU Student)
prop-nrb-002.text: Is this walking distance to TRM and Lumumba Drive stage? Looking for a quiet bedsitter for my final semester.

replies.author: Grace Wambui (Caretaker)
replies.text: Yes Kelvin! Exactly 4 minutes walk to TRM mall and Safaricom / Zuku wifi cables are ready in each room.

prop-nrb-003.author: Dr. Sarah Nduta
prop-nrb-003.text: The finishes on the kitchen and bathrooms in this building are top standard. Generator kicks in within 5 seconds during power cuts.

prop-bnb-001.author: Marcus & Linda (Safari Travellers)
prop-bnb-001.text: Stayed here for 4 nights before flying to Maasai Mara! Self check-in keypad was flawless and Netflix on the Smart TV was great.
